messages:
laura: Quick async check — planning to flip feature flag `cache_batch_prefetch_v3` to 5% prod canary at 18:30 UTC today. Need eyes on metrics, rollback steps, and any gotchas from infra. :eyes:
mike: Which pool(s) are in the canary?
laura: Only `prod-gpu-pool-a` (we'll route via traffic-slice tag `canary_cache_v3`). No other pools.
sanjay: SGTM. Key metrics: generation p95 (Console -> /routes/generation/token-latency), KV hit rate, errors by model variant, and token throughput per replica. Also watch cold-start counts.
jen: I can add a temporary alert: p95 > 200ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% -> auto rollback. Want that? :+1:
laura: Yes please add it. Rollback commands for quick reference:
```bash
# CLI rollback
redwood-ctl flags set cache_batch_prefetch_v3 0 --environment=prod
# Console: toggle flag -> audience = none
```
mike: Last time we saw a cold-start spike causing latency blips when scale-up happened. Can we enable short sampling for cold_start metric (30m)?
laura: will enable sampling for 30m before flip.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] flip flag `cache_batch_prefetch_v3` -> audience: `canary_cache_v3` at 2026-03-18T18:30Z
sanjay: I'll be watching starting 18:20. Ping @oncall if anything looks off.
oncall-bot: oncall pager rota reminder: sanjay (primary) 18:00-06:00 UTC.
jen: alert rule `canary-cachebatch-p95` added and dashboard row for `kv_hit_rate` created.
mike: LGTM. :+1:
laura: rolling now. will post quick numbers at +5m and +20m.
laura: +5m: p95 95ms (baseline 92ms), kv_hit_rate 78% (baseline 76%), errors 0.03% — looks clean. :tada:
sanjay: watching logs, no new 5xxs. Noted one cold_start spike on pod-23 (OOM). Might be memory limit too small for this variant.
laura: ack. temporarily scale pool-a +1 replica and bump memory on pod-23; will monitor 5m.
mike: can we capture heap/profile dump for pod-23 and file an incident?
laura: file created: incidents/1898766000 with a short note + stack traces.
jen: unless p95 > 150ms or errors > 0.5% I think we can go to 20% in 30m.
sanjay: agreed, stop and rollback if thresholds breached.
laura: noted. I'll announce when we reach 20% and close the thread after verification.
deploy-bot: rollout complete — increased audience `canary_cache_v3` from 5% -> 20% at 2026-03-18T20:00Z
